title: feat(foundry): Reverse Engineering taxonomy v1 — polyhierarchy, toolchains, validator
body:
[MUSEai]@{role:{reverse-engineering-toolkits}} Owner order (2026-10-28): collaborator-supplied taxonomy example (Perplexity export: cybersecurity polyhierarchy + RE category/toolchain map) — start OUR version + file improvement research (research request filed separately via research-intake).

Our version, as working registry not essay:
- ops/reverse_engineering/taxonomy.json (re-taxonomy/v1): 37 nodes, 8 toolchains. Primary tree by target (native/bytecode/scripts/firmware/protocols/hardware/mobile/web-client); method+objective as tag axes; overlap structural (extra parents + tags) not prose; work families (malware, CTF) distinct from targets; Android cross-parenting encoded (mobile-android <-> bytecode-android-dex: manifest/DEX/native are three layers).
- Fleet placed: apk-xref belt (#2143) as Android acquire/extract/cross-validator, Web Adapter Foundry as web-client factory + its taxonomy.json named sub-registry, Kali as workspace node (ci-remote, B160V law), FLARE-VM/Ghidra/Frida/JADX/Apktool/Binwalk/QEMU/debuggers placed by tool_role. Kinds distinct: platform != discipline != credential != format (umbrella context recorded, not modelled).
- ops/reverse_engineering/taxonomy.py: validator (unique ids, parents resolve, acyclic, root reachability, axis vocab, tool_role required, toolchain stage order + real tools, overlap/example refs resolve) + query CLI (validate/node/toolchain/overlap). Tests 7/7; 40/40 alongside apk-xref + foundry suites.
- docs/ops/REVERSE-ENGINEERING-TAXONOMY.md: diff-vs-example table, shape, sibling registries, and the improvement-research scoped question (v2 gaps: iOS bytecode, WASM-first chains, symbolic/concolic, axis vocab vs Kali catalog/ATT&CK/WSTG, measured vs qualitative overlap).
